name: minigames-arcade
description: Seven free browser games — bundled and Capacitor-wrappable for iOS/Android.

scripts.cap:init: echo 'Run once: npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/ios @capacitor/android && npx cap init MiniGames com.philipposk.minigames --web-dir=.'
scripts.build:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
